items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: Clark Terry, Benny Bailey, Lennie Johnson, and Larry, another lead player.

ctx.x: Clark Terry, Benny Bailey, Lennie Johnson, and Larry, another lead player. I think his first name was Larry. He was awesome. And then Floyd Standifer my dear friend. Floyd Standifer you’ve never heard of.
